articles.title: Datalinx AI Raises $4.2M Seed Round to Solve Data Readiness Challenges for Enterprise Marketing
articles.mainIdea: Datalinx AI Raises $4.2M Seed Round to Solve Data Readiness Challenges for Enterprise Marketing
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Datalinx AI Raises $4.2M Seed Round to Solve Data Readiness Challenges for Enterprise Marketing. Datalinx Founders Picture Datalinx Founders Picture NEW YORK, Jan. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Datalinx AI, the AI data refinery that turns complex data into AI and application-ready assets, announced today that it has raised $4.2 million in Seed funding to help enterprise marketing and data organizations grow revenue through faster, trusted data access. The oversubscribed round was led by High Alpha, with co-investment from Databricks Ventures and Aperiam, along with investors Frederic Kerrest
